caption: The drawing features a single object—a coat rack—depicted with thin, black, linear outlines on a light beige background. The coat rack consists of a vertical central pole with a small rectangular block at the top and three hooks extending from the upper portion; two of the hooks curve outward to the sides, and one faces forward. Below the hooks, there are three diagonal supports connecting the hooks structure to the central pole. The coat rack stands on a base with three wide, curved legs that extend outward, each ending in a rounded tip. The entire drawing is centered on the page, and there are no additional objects, backgrounds, or colors present beyond the beige of the paper and the black lines of the illustration.
